comment: pmunity convert config for the box64 route's GLES mode (docs/box64-route.md): GLES 3 programs next to every shader's OpenGL Core ones, and OpenGL ES 3 added before OpenGL Core in the build's graphics API list, which lets the Linux player's -force-gles switch take effect. The player's own built-in shaders already carry GLES 3 programs.
